The stated reliability is experimentally stipulated, not a source-derived performance estimate. The verification proposal concerns the source-listed alarm function; no additional hazardous consequence is assigned to high flow. A demand means a high-flow alarm demand after the proposed verification work. Success means delivery of the intended high-flow indication in the control room. There are exactly two mutually exclusive and exhaustive outcomes per demand: successful delivery of this specified function, or unavailability of this function.
